# linux_user (Data Source)

Reads a user account, like `getent passwd`. A missing account is not an error: `exists` is `false` and the other attributes are null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linux_user" "www" {
  name = "www-data"
}

resource "linux_directory" "site" {
  path  = "/var/www/site"
  owner = data.linux_user.www.name
  group = data.linux_user.www.group
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the user.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Comment (GECOS field).
- `exists` (Boolean) Whether the account exists.
- `gid` (Number) ID of the primary group.
- `group` (String) Primary group.
- `groups` (Set of String) Supplementary groups.
- `home` (String) Home directory.
- `id` (String) Name of the user.
- `shell` (String) Login shell.
- `uid` (Number) User ID.
